events.evidence: It is revealed a recent airstrike mounted by Israel against an airbase in Syria targeted an Iranian Tor missile air defence system
A bomb explodes at a football match between Bulgarian rivals Levski Sofia and CSKA at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia, injuring two police officers
Iran's central bank officially switches from using the U.S. dollar to the euro in its international transactions.

label.note: Israel-Iran strike revelation, terror incidents and Iran dollar-to-euro switch add geopolitical caution.
